answer: The design leans on receipt hashes checked against public logs before trust. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the pigment of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Each submission hangs on the canyon of a task receipt, and the jade is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a short declarative sentences, one technical clause register, it stays short.
